headline: Nasdaq gained 1.2% as chips led a second day of Anthropic-driven AI buying, but the dollar firmed sharply.
brief: The Nasdaq Composite rose 1.2% to about 26,478, closing in the upper third of its range, as semiconductors jumped over 3% and VIX fell to about 17.5 while the 10-year held near 4.99%. No BOJ decision or major China data falls in tonight's Asia session, and no mega-cap reported after the bell, so a stronger dollar (EUR/USD -0.5%, USD/JPY near 157.9) and positioning ahead of Wednesday's FOMC decision and Microsoft/Alphabet earnings are the main drivers. Key risk is a hawkish-pause repricing or dollar strength fading the AI rally before those events.

sources.title: Nasdaq rises 1.2% as Anthropic rally extends (Eurasia Business News)
